szoveg_eredeti:
Thanks for having me, President Costa. Europe holds all the technology and talent needed to lead the AI race. What we need now is greater speed, bolder financing, and tight coordination among Member States. The choice is ours.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Arthur Mensch megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: António Costa (@eucopresident); megjelent: 2026-11-13T15:33:21+00:00; link: https://x.com/eucopresident/status/2121265166520054139; média: videó, 25 másodperc]
AI is the most important technology of our time. 

Europe must make the most of its benefits, from higher productivity to better public services. 

We must also manage the risks and changes it will bring – and help set global standards for responsible governance and safe, human-centric AI.
